dropped.item: "You're first in line" for preorderers (largely redundant with the line about shipping first)

changed.item: Subject line changed from 'The Tidekeepers is here' (implies available now) to 'goes live October 21'. The release date matches the body, but the framing changed from present availability to a future launch.
The call to action is now addressed only to people who haven't preordered ('If you haven't, head to the shop'). The original addressed anyone ('Want one?').
